chunks: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but comes before Ar-Rahman in all obedience.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنِ: The Merciful, one of the divine names
key_terms.عَبْدًا: A servant or slave, indicating submission and servitude

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about all beings coming before God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine reckoning for all creatures, highlighting the transition from servitude to accountability. It serves as a foundational reminder of human humility before the Almighty, reinforcing the concept that all existence ultimately returns to its Creator for judgment.
